questions.q:

questions.e: protect = bảo vệ (loài nguy cấp).

questions.q:

After graduating, she wants to ______ a career in medicine.
questions.e: “pursue a career” = theo đuổi sự nghiệp.

questions.q:
Choose the best option to complete the sentence.

questions.e: CV (sơ yếu lí lịch) là giấy tờ cần chuẩn bị khi xin việc.

questions.q:
Choose the best option to complete the sentence.
Nurses need to be caring and ______ when they work with patients.
questions.e: Song song với tính từ “caring” → tính từ “patient” (kiên nhẫn); “impatient” trái nghĩa, không phù hợp.

questions.q:

questions.q:

questions.t: Unit 6 – Grammar: Active and passive causatives
questions.q:
Choose the best option to complete the sentence.
She got her assistant ______ the report.
questions.e: Thể nhờ vả chủ động với “get”: get + người + to V → got her assistant to type.

questions.q:
Choose the best option to complete the sentence.
Please ______ any words you don't know in the dictionary.
questions.e: look up (a word) = tra (từ) trong từ điển.

questions.q:

questions.e: Tường thuật với “said”, mốc “over the previous century” → lùi về quá khứ hoàn thành: had fallen; các phương án khác sai cấu trúc.

questions.t: Unit 9 – Grammar: Clauses of condition and concession

questions.e: unless = if … not: Bạn sẽ không được nhận trừ khi có kĩ năng giao tiếp tốt.

questions.t: Unit 9 – Grammar: Clauses of condition and concession
questions.q:

______ he had little experience, he was offered the job.
questions.e: Quan hệ tương phản, sau chỗ trống là mệnh đề → Although; Despite/Because of đi với cụm danh từ.

questions.t: Unit 9 – Grammar: Clauses of condition and concession
questions.q:

questions.e: provided that = với điều kiện là.

questions.q:
Choose the best option to complete the sentence.
If I had studied harder at school, I ______ a better job now.
questions.e: Câu điều kiện hỗn hợp: điều kiện trái quá khứ (had studied) – kết quả trái hiện tại (now) → would + V: would have.

questions.q:
Choose the best option to complete the sentence.
If she weren't so busy, she ______ the online course last month.
questions.e: Câu điều kiện hỗn hợp: điều kiện trái hiện tại (weren't so busy – tính cách/tình trạng lâu dài) – kết quả trái quá khứ (last month) → would have + V3.

questions.q:
Choose the most suitable response to complete the exchange.
Teacher: “What do you want to be in the future?”
Nam: “______”
o: I'd like to become a software engineer.
questions.e: Câu hỏi về nghề nghiệp tương lai → “I'd like to become …”.

questions.q:
Choose the most suitable response to complete the exchange.
Mai: “I've just been offered a job at a big tech company!”
Lan: “______”
questions.e: Đáp lại tin vui → chúc mừng.

questions.q:
Choose the correct arrangement of the sentences to make a meaningful conversation.
a. Nam: Because I'm good at maths and I love making apps.
b. Lan: Why do you want to study computer science?
c. Lan: That sounds great. Good luck with your entrance exam!
d. Nam: I'm going to apply to study computer science at university.
questions.e: Nam nói dự định (d) → Lan hỏi lí do (b) → Nam giải thích (a) → Lan chúc may mắn (c).

questions.q:
Choose the correct arrangement of the sentences to make a meaningful paragraph.
a. Moreover, many employers now prefer workers who keep updating their skills.
b. In today's fast-changing world, lifelong learning has become more important than ever.
c. For these reasons, everyone should develop the habit of learning throughout their lives.
d. New technologies appear every year, so the knowledge we learn at school soon becomes out of date.
questions.e: Câu chủ đề (b) → lí do thứ nhất (d) → “Moreover” lí do thứ hai (a) → kết luận “For these reasons” (c).

questions.q:
Read the passage and answer the question.

In the past, people believed that education ended when they left school or university. Today, this idea is out of date. Because technology is developing so fast, the skills that workers need are changing all the time. Therefore, many people are now choosing to become lifelong learners.

Lifelong learning means continuing to gain knowledge and skills throughout your life. It can be formal, such as taking a university course in the evening, or informal, such as learning to cook from online videos or reading books about a new topic. Thanks to the Internet, it has never been easier to learn something new. There are thousands of free online courses on almost every subject, from computer programming to photography.

Lifelong learning brings many benefits. First, it helps people keep their jobs and get promoted, because employers value workers who can adapt to change. Second, learning new things keeps the brain active. Some studies suggest that older people who keep learning are less likely to have memory problems. Finally, lifelong learning can make life more enjoyable by helping people discover new hobbies and meet people with similar interests.

Of course, it is not always easy to find time to study when you have a job and a family. However, even fifteen minutes a day can make a big difference. The key is to stay curious and never stop asking questions.

What is the passage mainly about?
o: The meaning and benefits of lifelong learning
How to find a job after school
questions.e: Bài giải thích học tập suốt đời là gì, các hình thức và lợi ích của nó.

questions.q:
Choose the underlined part that needs correction in the following sentence:
(A) Despite (B) she had no experience, she (C) was offered (D) the job.
questions.e: Sau “Despite” phải là cụm danh từ/V-ing; ở đây là mệnh đề → đổi thành Although.

questions.q:
Choose the underlined part that needs correction in the following sentence:
If I (A) had learnt English when I was young, I (B) will have (C) more job opportunities (D) now.
questions.e: Câu điều kiện hỗn hợp (trái quá khứ → kết quả hiện tại “now”): will have → would have.

questions.q:
Choose the sentence that is closest in meaning to the given one.
I didn't take the computer course, so I can't use this software now.
o: If I had taken the computer course, I can use this software now.
If I had taken the computer course, I could use this software now.
If I hadn't taken the computer course, I couldn't use this software now.
If I took the computer course, I could have used this software now.
questions.e: Điều kiện trái quá khứ (had taken) – kết quả trái hiện tại (now) → could + V; đổi phủ định thành khẳng định.

questions.q:
Choose the sentence that is closest in meaning to the given one.
You must have a degree to apply for this job.
o: You can apply for this job unless you have a degree.
You can't apply for this job unless you have a degree.
Unless you don't have a degree, you can't apply for this job.
You can't apply for this job if you have a degree.
questions.e: unless = if not: Không thể nộp đơn trừ khi có bằng cấp; “unless” không đi với mệnh đề phủ định.
